subject: Next Steps: NovaCorp Trial Guardrails & Eval Split Proposal
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novacorp.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Next Steps: NovaCorp Trial Guardrails & Eval Split Proposal

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the productive conversation today. Quick recap and a proposed plan so we can align on a light, low-friction trial that proves value and keeps procurement comfortable. Attaching the initial trial charter and a draft grading rubric for the evaluation.

Discovery highlights (as I heard them):
- Goal: reduce triage time for customer support by surfacing suggested responses and routing labels (target 40% reduction in avg handle time)
- Data: 6 months of anonymized ticket history; PI/PHI out-of-scope for the trial
- Constraints: offline shadowing for compliance is preferred but they want a path to an online shadow if results look strong

Proposed trial approach (two-path option):
1) Shadow-first (recommended) — Redwood runs a live shadow alongside production; model suggestions are logged and scored but never surfaced to end-users. Provides realistic behavior and latency data.
2) Offline batch evaluation — extract representative slices, run our scoring offline to validate quality before enabling any shadow. Faster to start but may miss query distribution edge-cases.

Success criteria (suggested):
- Precision@1 >= 72% on high-confidence routing suggestions (observed in shadow logs)
- Avg suggestion latency (p90) < 120ms when shadowing in-region
- No PII incidents; audit log completeness for every inference request

Proposed timeline:
- Kickoff prep & data delivery: by 2026-05-22
- Offline baseline run (if chosen): 1 week after data delivery
- Shadow run (2 weeks): starts after baseline or immediately if NovaCorp approves
- Final review & acceptance: 2026-06-18

Ownership:
- Redwood: Rishi (trial lead), Soojin (infra & eval tooling), Ben (customer success)
- NovaCorp: Elena (product), procurement@novacorp.com (procurement)

Open items for you to confirm:
- Preferred starting path: shadow-first or offline baseline?
- Data delivery window and point-of-contact for SFTP or Drive?
- Any additional compliance checks procurement needs before shadowing begins?

Next step: if this looks reasonable, I’ll update the trial charter and rubric and propose a calendar invite for the kickoff sync (30–45m) the week of 5/25.

Attachments: novacorp_trial_charter_v1.pdf, evaluation_rubric.xlsx

Thanks —
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Sr. Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0173

From: Elena Morales <elena@novacorp.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novacorp.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 08:14:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next Steps: NovaCorp Trial Guardrails & Eval Split Proposal

Rishi —

Thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. This aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Procurement will need an explicit data handling statement and confirmation that no PHI or PII will be sent for the trial — I looped procurement above.
2) We’d prefer to start with an offline baseline to validate quality quickly; if that shows promise, we’ll greenlight shadowing. That said, we are open to a short, strictly-logged shadow if Redwood can provide the audit log format up front.
3) Point of contact for data is me, but we’ll use a dedicated SFTP account; can you share preferred file layout and sample manifest?

Can you send over the updated charter with the data handling blurb and a short example of the audit log (what fields you capture per request)? If procurement signs off, we’ll target data delivery the week of 5/25.

Best,
Elena Morales
Product Lead — Customer Experience, NovaCorp
elena@novacorp.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 08:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next Steps: NovaCorp Trial Guardrails & Eval Split Proposal

Rishi / Ben —

Quick notes after reading Elena’s reply and the charter:

- Data handling statement: propose the following short paragraph for the charter: "Redwood will process only the ticket text and non-identifying metadata for the purpose of model evaluation. Customer-managed redaction is required for any field that may contain PII prior to transfer; Redwood will not attempt to de-identify customer-owned data during the trial. All inference logs will be retained for 90 days and are available for audit upon request."

- Audit log example (CSV fields): request_id, timestamp_utc, model_name, prompt_hash, response_hash, confidence_score, matched_label, route_suggestion, redaction_flag, matched_rule_ids

- Rubric tweaks: add a separate row for "safety/PII escapes" with a pass/fail flag; failures are disqualifying for that run. Also suggest we include a concordance metric for high-frequency intents (top 10 intents) so Nova gets a sense of per-intent performance.

- Offline vs Shadow: Since they prefer offline first, we should propose a two-stage cadence in the charter: 3 business days for an offline baseline report, then a 10–14 day shadow contingent on baseline passing gates. That keeps the timeline tight but controlled.

I updated evaluation_rubric.xlsx (minor) and drafted trial_charter_v1b.pdf with the data handling text. Attaching both.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee | Platform Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.ai
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novacorp.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, procurement@novacorp.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next Steps: NovaCorp Trial Guardrails & Eval Split Proposal

Elena —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the preference for offline-first. Next steps and owners below — I’ll also upload the updated charter and rubric to the Drive link and send a calendar invite for a 30m kickoff.

Confirmed plan:
- Path: Offline baseline (3 business days) → conditional 10–14 day shadow if baseline meets gates
- Data delivery window: week of 2026-05-25; format: CSV manifest + gzipped CSV batches (manifest example attached)
- Audit logs: sample schema included (see charter); Redwood will provide logs for every inference and retain for 90 days

Gates to enter shadow (pass all):
- Offline precision@1 >= 72% on the provided sample
- Zero safety/PII failures in offline run
- Procurement sign-off on data handling language

Owners & invites:
- Data transfer & manifest: Elena (NovaCorp) / Ben (Redwood)
- Offline run & report: Soojin (Redwood)
- Shadow infra & latency monitoring: Lauren (Redwood)
- Commercial & contract questions: Rishi (Redwood) / procurement@novacorp.com

Target dates:
- Data handoff confirmation: by 2026-05-25 EOD
- Offline baseline complete: ~2026-05-28
- Shadow window (if approved): 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-14
- Final review: 2026-06-18

Attachments: novacorp_trial_charter_v1b.pdf, evaluation_rubric.xlsx

If that all looks good, I’ll schedule the kickoff for 5/26 or 5/27 (pick a 30–45m slot).

Thanks —
Rishi
